issue.title: Next UI: Key component, component gallery and Figma-to-component workflow
issue.body:
Pilot for building Next UI components from the ETEN × Fluent Figma file. It lands the hardware Key (in its key deck) and the Switch as reference components, a flag-gated component gallery for reviewing them on a device, the theme pieces they need, and the workflow docs and agent skill for the next ones.

Figma: [Key](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2326-34) · [Switch](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2326-41) · [Hardware panel keys](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2411-465)

Scope is one PR by request (Joe Skager), since the pieces only make sense together as a worked example.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `Key` renders Default, Pressed / latched and Disabled from Figma Key (`2326:34`) using only theme tokens (no Figma screen uses `Lip=false`, so it's not demoed; the `lip` prop stays to mirror Figma); Disabled keeps the key solid and fades only the icon (Figma updated to match)
- [ ] Press sinks the face `space/4` over `motion/press`, releases over `motion/release` with `ease-standard`, with no flash on release; reduce motion snaps
- [ ] `KeyDeck` frames transport keys in `surface/inverse` with `space/2` seams (Figma `2411:465`)
- [ ] `Switch` renders Off / On / Disabled from Figma Switch (`2326:41`), all reachable in the gallery demo, with a 48dp touch target and a toggle haptic
- [ ] Haptics via `useHaptics()`: `Virtual_Key` / `Toggle_On|Off` in Next, nothing in Legacy, nothing for the whole take (recording or paused)
- [ ] Foundations roles, elevation, motion, disabled opacity, icon sizes, `radius.xs` and `spacing.xxs` are reachable through `useTheme()`; Legacy snapshot changes are additive only
- [ ] Canvas, Hardware and Accent modes resolve through `ColorModeScope`; `accent/record` matches Figma in every mode (Canvas `red/500`, Accent `red/300`)
- [ ] Component gallery at `fluent://gallery`, signed in or out, always Next, with a mode switcher and live demos only; enabled for development / preview / nightly and never production
- [ ] Workflow guide, `figma-component` skill, theme audit and `npm run api:coverage` committed, including the screen-wiring scrub and the PR "Existing functionality" table

Needs QA? Yes (new native module `expo-haptics`; haptics and press feel need a real device)
